karat_source_name: eCFR - 16 CFR 23.3, Misrepresentation as to gold content
karat_basis: Nominal karat/24 arithmetic for a documented gold-alloy weight. The percentage is arithmetic on the listed karat, not a quoted percentage and not an assay. 16 CFR 23.3 (read 2026-10-23) distinguishes fine 24-karat gold, gold alloys and surface coatings; the FTC consumer page states the karat parts in words ('18 parts gold mixed with six parts of another metal').
